name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Search Visibility Manager · SEO, Analytics & AI/LLM Systems
summary: Marketing operations leader with 15+ years in SEO, analytics, and full-funnel digital strategy, including technical SEO audits, keyword and competitive research, and GA4/Search Console/Semrush/Ahrefs-based reporting built for executive audiences. I also design and direct AI/LLM systems, translating loosely-formed business intent into structured prompts and agent logic, which is the same discipline behind making a brand's content extractable, citable, and well-represented inside AI-generated answers. Comfortable owning strategy end to end, not just executing against someone else's plan, and presenting results directly to leadership.
